preview.text: Western Australia and New South Wales meet in a one-day match at the W.A.C.A. Ground, where eight recorded one-day meetings show three wins for Western Australia and five for New South Wales. New South Wales won the toss and chose to bat first, aiming for a usual first-innings score of 249 at the venue. The forecast for the next 8 hours is up to a 2 per cent chance of rain and about 18 degrees.

summary.text: New South Wales won by 78 runs. NSW made 371-8, Sam Konstas top-scoring with 149 off 131 balls; Ashton Agar took 2 for 60. WA made 293-10, Sam Whiteman top-scoring with 116 off 113 balls; Jack Nisbet took 3 for 47. Sides batting first at W.A.C.A. Ground usually make about 249.
